judgement.reason: WeKan needs a MongoDB wire-protocol database, either external MongoDB or a bundled FerretDB server whose SQLite data lives on local disk, and Deployz provides neither MongoDB nor persistent disk.

evidence.quote: #   WEKAN_DB=mongodb   -> never start FerretDB; use external MONGO_URL (a mongod
#   WEKAN_DB=ferretdb  -> start the bundled FerretDB (SQLite) on 127.0.0.1:27017
- FerretDB v1 with SQLite, the default on every platform - bundle, Docker,
